stories.title: Man charged over burglaries and car thefts including offences in Buckley and Marford
stories.summary: A man has been charged in connection with a series of burglaries and car thefts, including offences in Buckley and Marford. Bryan Thomas, 27, of no fixed abode, Merseyside, has been charged with seven counts of burglary, seven counts of theft of a motor vehicle and one count of escaping lawful custody. stories.title: Flintshire meets recycling target but £1m fine still looms
stories.summary: Flintshire County Council still has a Welsh Government fine of more than £1 million hanging over it for missing a statutory recycling target. stories.title: 24 hours, two sunrises, 12,503 nautical miles: A350 with Broughton wings breaks world record
stories.summary: An Airbus A350 has broken the world record for the longest flight by distance by a commercial airliner. Wings for the A350 are built at Airbus’s Broughton site, which has made wings for Airbus aircraft for more than 50 years. stories.title: Four new gritters join Flintshire fleet a year after Alltami depot fire
stories.summary: Four new gritters are joining Flintshire County Council’s fleet, a year after a fire at its Alltami depot destroyed four gritters. The council said the replacement vehicles come as teams prepare for another winter of round-the-clock maintenance on the county’s roads. stories.title: Unleaded down 6p a litre around Deeside in a month as diesel falls by less than 2p
stories.summary: Unleaded petrol has fallen by an average of 6.1p a litre at forecourts around Deeside in the past month, but diesel has dropped by less than 2p.
